description: Per-frame pinhole camera of the handheld match recording (scripts/own-video-camera.py). Columns per frame: rvec (Rodrigues, world -> camera), t_mm, PnP residual px against the frame's ice-plane homography, camera centre in world mm. Project a world point X (mm, z up) with cv2.projectPoints(X, rvec, t, K, None).
status_note: Rests on the assumed ice-plane calibration (preview scale, goal.W at the video's left) and on the assumed intrinsics: square pixels, principal point at the image centre, one focal length for the whole video.

slot_check.method: share of projected slot-centreline points darker than both neighbours 4 px away (by 8 grey levels); every 5th frame
